name: cn.dianyinhuoban.hm.mvp.me.view.BindBankCardActivity
description: The Dianyin Guanjia Hongmeng Edition (电银管家泓盟版) SDK from holderman has a screen that collects the cardholder name, bank, and card number when a user adds or updates a bank card for account payments or withdrawals.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to add or update a bank card through this screen.
